insights.summary: The Salesforce integration stops writing call data to custom objects when fields or picklist values change.
insights.quote: When Robert's team added a field to our Loan Application object, the Salesforce sync just stopped writing call records to the custom objects.

insights.summary: Dynamic number insertion stops swapping numbers after client-side route changes on single-page apps.
insights.quote: On our new single-page application, once the borrower moves past the first step, dynamic number insertion stops swapping the number.
